extra.tooMany:
{{pokemonName}} has too many
of this relic!

PokemonHpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} HP or {{restorePercent}}% HP for one Mogger Mon, whichever is higher.

extra.fully: Fully restores HP for one Mogger Mon.
extra.fullyWithStatus: Fully restores HP for one Mogger Mon and heals any status ailment.

PokemonReviveModifierType.description: Revives one Mogger Mon and restores {{restorePercent}}% HP.

PokemonStatusHealModifierType.description: Heals any status ailment for one Mogger Mon.

PokemonPpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for one Mogger Mon technique.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for one Mogger Mon technique.

PokemonAllMovePpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores {{restorePoints}} PP for all of one Mogger Mon’s techniques.

extra.fully: Restores all PP for all of one Mogger Mon’s techniques.

PokemonPpUpModifierType.description: Permanently increases PP for one Mogger Mon technique by {{upPoints}} for every 5 maximum PP (maximum 3).

PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.name: {{natureName}} Tonic
PokemonNatureChangeModifierType.description: Changes a Mogger Mon’s nature to {{natureName}} and permanently unlocks the nature for the recruit.

DoubleBattleChanceBoosterModifierType.description: Quadruples the chance of an encounter being a double battle for up to {{battleCount}} battles.

TempStatStageBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the {{stat}} of all party members by {{amount}} for up to 5 battles.

AttackTypeBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the power of a Mogger Mon’s {{moveType}}-type techniques by 20%.

PokemonLevelIncrementModifierType.description: Increases a Mogger Mon’s level by {{levels}}.

AllPokemonLevelIncrementModifierType.description: Increases all party members’ level by {{levels}}.

BaseStatBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s base {{stat}} by 10%. The higher your IVs, the higher the stack limit.

PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.name: Dream Cake
PokemonBaseStatFlatModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s {{stats}} base stats by {{statValue}}. Found after a strange dream.

AllPokemonFullHpRestoreModifierType.description: Restores 100% HP for all Mogger Mon.

AllPokemonFullReviveModifierType.description: Revives all fainted Mogger Mon, fully restoring HP.

ExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonExpBoosterModifierType.description: Increases the holder’s gain of EXP. Points by {{boostPercent}}%.

PokemonMultiHitModifierType.description: Converts 25% of damage from the holder’s attacks into an additional strike.

TmModifierType.name: BrainDance {{moveId}} - {{moveName}}
TmModifierType.description: Load {{moveName}} onto a Mogger Mon with a BrainDance disc.

TmModifierTypeWithInfo.name: BrainDance {{moveId}} - {{moveName}}
TmModifierTypeWithInfo.description:
Load {{moveName}} onto a Mogger Mon with a BrainDance disc.
(Hold C or Shift for more info).

EvolutionItemModifierType.description: Causes certain Mogger Mon to maxx.

FormChangeItemModifierType.description: Causes certain Mogger Mon to change form.

FusePokemonModifierType.description: Combines two Mogger Mon (transfers Trait, splits base stats and types, shares technique pool).

TerastallizeModifierType.name: {{teraType}} Prism Shard
TerastallizeModifierType.description: Changes the Mogger Mon’s Prism Type to {{teraType}}.

ContactHeldItemTransferChanceModifierTyp.description: Upon attacking, there is a {{chancePercent}}% chance the foe’s held relic will be stolen.

TurnHeldItemTransferModifierType.description: Every turn, the holder acquires one held relic from the foe.

EnemyAttackStatusEffectChanceModifierTyp.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance to inflict {{statusEffect}} with attack techniques.

EnemyEndureChanceModifierType.description: Adds a {{chancePercent}}% chance of enduring a hit.

TERA_ORB.name: Prism Core
TERA_ORB.description: Allows your Mogger Mon to Prism Shift. Recharges slowly. Prism Shards also become available.

MAP.name: Route Map
MAP.description: Allows you to choose your destination at a crossroads.

REVIVER_SEED.name: Second Wind Seed
REVIVER_SEED.description: Revives the holder for 1/2 HP upon fainting from a direct hit.

WHITE_HERB.name: Blank Herb
WHITE_HERB.description: A relic to be held by a Mogger Mon. It will restore any lowered stat in battle.

MEMORY_MUSHROOM.name: Recall Spore
MEMORY_MUSHROOM.description: Recall one Mogger Mon’s forgotten technique.

EXP_SHARE.name: Share Link
EXP_SHARE.description: Non-participants receive 20% of a single participant’s EXP. Points.

EXP_BALANCE.name: Balance Link
EXP_BALANCE.description: Weighs EXP. Points received from battles towards lower-leveled party members.

OVAL_CHARM.name: Nest Charm
OVAL_CHARM.description: When multiple Mogger Mon participate in a battle, each gets an extra 10% of the total EXP.

SCOPE_LENS.name: Weakpoint Lens
SCOPE_LENS.description: It’s a lens for scoping out weak points. It boosts the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

LEEK.name: Long Stalk
LEEK.description: This very long and stiff stalk of leek boosts the critical-hit ratio of long-stalk recruits’ techniques.

EVIOLITE.name: Mutastone
EVIOLITE.description: This mysterious maxx shard boosts the Defense and Sp. Def stats when held by a Mogger Mon that can still maxx.

SOUL_DEW.name: Soul Mist
SOUL_DEW.description: Increases the influence of a Mogger Mon’s nature on its stats by 10% (additive).

GOLDEN_PUNCH.name: Golden Punch
GOLDEN_PUNCH.description: Grants 50% of direct damage inflicted as money.

COIN_CASE.name: Cash Case
COIN_CASE.description: After every 10th battle, receive 10% of your money in interest.

LOCK_CAPSULE.name: Lock Case
LOCK_CAPSULE.description: Allows you to lock relic rarities when rerolling relics.

HEALING_CHARM.name: Healing Charm
HEALING_CHARM.description: Increases the effectiveness of HP restoring techniques and relics by 10% (excludes Revives).

CANDY_JAR.name: Candy Jar
CANDY_JAR.description: Increases the number of levels added by Rare Candy relics by 1.

BERRY_POUCH.name: Zaza Stash
BERRY_POUCH.description: Adds a 30% chance that a used zaza will not be consumed.

FOCUS_BAND.name: Resolve Band
FOCUS_BAND.description: Adds a 10% chance to survive with 1 HP after being damaged enough to faint.

QUICK_CLAW.name: Snap Claw
QUICK_CLAW.description: Adds a 10% chance to technique first regardless of speed (after priority).

KINGS_ROCK.name: Monarch Rock
KINGS_ROCK.description: Adds a 10% chance an attack technique will cause the opponent to flinch.

LEFTOVERS.name: Scraps
LEFTOVERS.description: Heals 1/16 of a Mogger Mon’s maximum HP every turn.

SHELL_BELL.name: Echo Shell
SHELL_BELL.description: Heals 1/8 of a Mogger Mon’s dealt damage.

TOXIC_ORB.name: Venom Core
TOXIC_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that exudes toxins when touched and will badly poison the holder during battle.

FLAME_ORB.name: Ember Core
FLAME_ORB.description: It’s a bizarre orb that gives off heat when touched and will affect the holder with a burn during battle.

MYSTICAL_ROCK.name: Mythic Rock
MYSTICAL_ROCK.description: Extends the duration of terrain and weather caused by the holder’s techniques or Traits by 2 turns.

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.name: Treasures
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_GIMMIGHOUL.description: This Mogger Mon loves treasure! Keep collecting treasure and something might happen!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.name: Rage Fist
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_PRIMEAPE.description:
Primeape maxxes when its rage surpasses the limits of its physical form!
Build up its rage by using the technique Rage Fist!

EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.name: Psyshield Bash
EVOLUTION_TRACKER_STANTLER.description: Stantler maxxes to adapt to harsh environments. Toughen up its defense by using the technique Psyshield Bash!

BATON.name: Relay Baton
BATON.description: Allows passing along effects when switching Mogger Mon, which also bypasses traps.

SHINY_CHARM.name: Glitch Charm
SHINY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Mogger Mon being Glitch.

ABILITY_CHARM.name: Trait Charm
ABILITY_CHARM.description: Dramatically increases the chance of a wild Mogger Mon having a Hidden Trait.

CATCHING_CHARM.name: Cryotank Charm
CATCHING_CHARM.description: Increases the chance of landing a critical Cryotank lock.

IV_SCANNER.name: IV Scanner
IV_SCANNER.description: Enables scanning the IVs of wild Mogger Mon.

GOLDEN_POKEBALL.name: Golden Cryotank
GOLDEN_POKEBALL.description: Adds 1 extra relic option at the end of every battle.

ENEMY_HEAL.name: Recovery Token
ENEMY_HEAL.description: Heals 2% of max HP every turn.

ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.name: Full Heal Token
ENEMY_STATUS_EFFECT_HEAL_CHANCE.description: Adds a 2.5% chance every turn to heal a status condition.

ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.name: Fusion Token
ENEMY_FUSED_CHANCE.description: Adds a 1% chance that a wild Mogger Mon will be a fusion.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.name: Sweet Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_GOOD.description: Increases all of the holder’s base stats. You were blessed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.name: Foul Shuckle Juice
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_SHUCKLE_JUICE_BAD.description: Decreases all of the holder’s base stats. You were cursed by the Shuckle.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.name: Tar Sludge
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_BLACK_SLUDGE.description: The stench is so powerful that shops will only sell you relics at a steep cost increase.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.name: Power Strap
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_MACHO_BRACE.description: Defeating a Mogger Mon grants the holder a stack of it. Each stack boosts stats a bit. Bonus at max stacks.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.name: Dream Cake
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_OLD_GATEAU.description: Increases some of the holder’s stats.

MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.name: Golden Bug Net
MYSTERY_ENCOUNTER_GOLDEN_BUG_NET.description: Imbues the owner with luck to find Bug Type Mogger Mon more often. Has a strange heft to it.
